title: LA Colossal – Son Mai 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Vietnamese woman in her early 20s, sleek high ponytail, natural face with a playful smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Vietnamese son mai lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer with gold-leaf lotus ponds, silver-leaf dragonflies, and crackled white eggshell clouds. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated on a low wooden bench, leaning back slightly with both hands planted on the bench behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee, torso facing the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch black lacquer platform stiletto thong sandals with a gold-leaf lotus toe ring and a slim ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, black with gold-leaf dots.

Background & Lighting: Vietnamese lacquer workshop with half-finished panels on the walls, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
